name: World: detail layers
about: Natural Earth 1:10m roads, railways, rivers, lakes and urban areas, and the GeoNames towns of 15,000 people or more, worldwide (roads, railways and rivers left to the finer sets where they exist: the UK skeleton and the regional sets of build-detail-skeleton.mjs). For the globe of the Three.js port (OKR KR2.2, KR2.7).
crs: WGS84 longitude, latitude in degrees (EPSG:4326 axis order lon, lat as GeoJSON)
heights: none (2D); terrain comes from the globe
format: skeleton-1: GeoJSON-like FeatureCollection with integer, delta-coded coordinates (q = 10^4); docklands/geo/skeleton.js unpack() gives GeoJSON

cells.y: floor((lat + 90) / size), counted from the south

levels.5: continental files for the regional and city views (levels 6 and 8)

cells.files: polygons whole in the cell of their bbox centre (file bbox = real extent); lines cut at the edges of the cells of their clip level (a piece per cell, id <feature>.<n>); points in their cell

properties.kind: motorway, trunk or primary (from the Natural Earth type and expressway flag)

levels.note: scale rank 5 or less, 0.02 degree tolerance, 0.002 degree grid
all within 3000 km of a testbed, 0.005 degree tolerance, 0.001 degree grid
within 3000 km of a testbed, 0.005 degree tolerance, 0.001 degree grid

layers.title: Rivers (Natural Earth 1:10m and its European supplement)
Lakes (Natural Earth 1:10m and its European supplement)

levels.note: within 3000 km of a testbed, 0.004 degree tolerance, 0.001 degree grid

layers.title: Cities and towns (GeoNames, 15,000 people or more)

properties.name: name
properties.kind: city (100,000 or more, or a capital) or town

levels.note: 150,000 people or more, or a capital
all of cities15000 (populated places, not sections or historical)

gazetteer.about: GeoNames cities15000: populated places of 15,000 people or more (and capitals), with the country (Natural Earth names)
gazetteer.key: the first two letters or digits of the folded name (docklands/geo/skeleton.js fold, gazKey); a name is also filed under its other-language form
fields: laIndex (into la: country or region; -1 none)

sources.natural-earth: Natural Earth 5.1.2 (public domain): ne_10m_roads, ne_10m_railroads, ne_10m_rivers_lake_centerlines, ne_10m_rivers_europe, ne_10m_lakes, ne_10m_lakes_europe, ne_10m_urban_areas
